name: Priorities Map
purpose: A visual aid to map and compare top of mind pri- orities for individual and organizational stakeholders.
whereUsed: The Priorities Map is best used in the Problem Space during the Awareness Phase (1.2 & 1.3) to “Identify Key Stakeholders” and “Frame Points of View.” It’s also useful in the Solution Space to confirm the priorities of various stakeholders.
why: We will quickly gain an understanding of how different stakeholders prioritize the same initiatives, their relative importance, their measures for success and the trade-offs they’re willing to make.
outcomes: Clear view of the relative importance of multiple stakeholder priorities
Understanding of similarities and differences among stakeholders
Definition of criteria by which stakeholders measure success

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “PROBLEM SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Review and refine top of mind initiatives
Determine priority of each initiative for each stakeholder
By initiative, establish success criteria for each stakeholder

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “SOLUTION SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Confirm priorities of different stakeholders have been taken into consideration for the initiative or solution
Compare and contrast importance of priorities to the different stakeholders
List key takeaways (Gaps, Risks, Actions, etc.)
